title: The thirteenth put doubles the table

steps.caption: put("1"): hashCode() is 0x00000031. Its high 16 bits are all zero, so spreading leaves it unchanged, and its low 4 bits pick bucket 1 of 16.
Bucket 1 was empty, so "1" becomes its only node. Size is now 1.

put("12"): hashCode() is 0x00000621. Its high 16 bits are all zero, so spreading leaves it unchanged, and its low 4 bits pick bucket 1 of 16.
Node 1 of bucket 1 holds "1", not "12".
"12" is not in bucket 1, so a new node goes at the head of the chain, in front of 1 other. Size is now 12.
put("13"): hashCode() is 0x00000622. Its high 16 bits are all zero, so spreading leaves it unchanged, and its low 4 bits pick bucket 2 of 16.
Node 1 of bucket 2 holds "2", not "13".
"13" is not in bucket 2, so a new node goes at the head of the chain, in front of 1 other. Size is now 13.
Size 13 is over the threshold of 12, so the table doubles from 16 to 32 buckets. Each node can only keep its index or move up by 16, and resize() relinks them one at a time.
"11" stays in bucket 0.
"12" stays in bucket 1.
"1" moves from bucket 1 to bucket 17 (1 + 16).
"13" stays in bucket 2.
"2" moves from bucket 2 to bucket 18 (2 + 16).
"3" moves from bucket 3 to bucket 19 (3 + 16).
"4" moves from bucket 4 to bucket 20 (4 + 16).
"5" moves from bucket 5 to bucket 21 (5 + 16).
"6" moves from bucket 6 to bucket 22 (6 + 16).
"7" moves from bucket 7 to bucket 23 (7 + 16).
"8" moves from bucket 8 to bucket 24 (8 + 16).
"9" moves from bucket 9 to bucket 25 (9 + 16).
"10" moves from bucket 15 to bucket 31 (15 + 16).
Every node is in its new bucket. The table now has 32 buckets and the next resize comes when the size passes 24.
